newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: WEGENER SHARES UP ON FORECAST, STAKE SALE.
newsitem.headline: WEGENER SHARES UP ON FORECAST, STAKE SALE.

text.p: Shares in Dutch publisher Wegener NV jumped 12.00 guilders or 7.5 percent to 172.90 guilders Friday after it issued a positive profit forecast and announced the sale of a stake in the TV10 television company.
Wegener said early on Friday that it expected its net profit and earnings per share to rise further in 1997, resulting from organic growth and past and future acquisitions.
On Thursday, the company said it was selling a majority interest in the TV10 Dutch commercial television station to Saban Entertainment Inc of the U.S. for an undisclosed sum.
